title: Every Fucking Website (2020)
author: doubletwoyou
relevanceReason: 命中 2 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: In case you're not aware, there's COVID-19 happening! Here's some stuff we wrote that you won't read.

You obviously know what cookies are. If we don't put this here, delighted lawyers from EU and CA will sue us. Not only this is very expensive, there are no browser settings to remove this, since every site does this differently. You voted for this! Also you have to click "I agree"
summaryZh: In case you're not aware, there's COVID-19 happening! Here's some stuff we wrote that you won't read.

You obviously know what cookies are. If we don't put this here, delighted lawyers from EU and CA will sue us. Not only this is very expensive, there are no browser settings to remove this, since every site does this differently. You voted for this! Also you have to click "I agree"

comments.author: jchw
comments.textRawHtml:
Should load much slower.

Also, where is the unrelated autoplaying video that will unmute if you actually click it, that follows your scrolling and only becomes smaller when you dismiss it? Plus, it should probably have text that cuts off letting you know you can have access for just $10/month.

Plus, isn't this website undissmissably "better in the app" after a few minutes of attempting to use it on a phone? Where's that at?

edit: Oh shoot! I forgot, too. This modal needs to also ensure there is absolutely no way to scroll. If you could scroll you might be able to accidentally get to the address bar of your browser to fix the URL to xcancel or even close the page, which isn't using the app as you are intended to do.

Also, it doesn't attempt to hijack the back button to give me stuff I clearly wanted to see before I leave the page.

A lot of work left to do here before it's a "real" website. Although, it has about as much substance as the average website so far, so good work on that.
comments.textZhHtml:
加载速度应该慢得多。

此外，如果您实际单击它，该视频将取消静音，它会跟随您的滚动，并且只有在您关闭它时才会变小，不相关的自动播放视频在哪里？另外，它可能应该有一些文字，让您知道您只需支付 10 美元/月即可访问。

此外，在尝试在手机上使用几分钟后，这个网站是否无可否认地“在应用程序中更好”？那在哪里？

编辑：天啊！我也忘记了该模式还需要确保绝对无法滚动。如果您可以滚动，您可能会意外地到达浏览器的地址栏，将 URL 修复为 xcancel，甚至关闭页面，这并没有像您预期的那样使用该应用程序。

此外，它不会尝试劫持后退按钮以在我离开页面之前为我提供我明确希望看到的内容。

在成为“真正的”网站之前，这里还有很多工作要做。尽管如此，到目前为止，它的内容与普通网站差不多，所以在这方面做得很好。

children.author: bee_rider
children.textRawHtml:
> Plus, isn't this website undissmissably "better in the app" after a few minutes of attempting to use it on a phone? Where's that at?

This is the most annoying thing on the internet. There’s a site I’d like to use, but “try the app” takes up the entire page (and appears to be impossible to dismiss?). Actually, is there a way to permanently request the desktop site for all future visits to a domain on iOS? There is no reason to visit this full-page app advertisement.
children.textZhHtml:
> 另外，在尝试在手机上使用该网站几分钟后，难道不是无可争议地“在应用程序中更好”吗？它在哪里？

这是互联网上最烦人的事情。我想使用一个网站，但“尝试该应用程序”占据了整个页面（并且似乎无法关闭？）。实际上，有没有一种方法可以永久请求桌面站点以用于将来对 iOS 上的域的所有访问？没有理由访问此全页应用广告。

children.author: dcminter
children.textRawHtml: eBay stops me from typing in the thing I want to search for so they can try to persuade me to use the app that I have expressed zero interest in for a decade or so. Guys, I'm trying to press money into your thieving little hands - why are you trying to stop me?
children.textZhHtml: eBay 阻止我输入我想要搜索的内容，这样他们就可以尝试说服我使用我在十年左右的时间里表示零兴趣的应用程序。伙计们，我正试图把钱塞进你们那偷窃的小手里——你们为什么要阻止我？

children.author: kmoser
children.textRawHtml:
They see it as a win because you've still been using their site for a decade now, and every time they advertise their app there's still a non-zero chance you'll relent, but if they stop pushing their app, that chance drops to zero.

The only winning move is not to play.
children.textZhHtml:
他们认为这是一次胜利，因为您已经使用他们的网站十年了，每次他们为他们的应用做广告时，您仍有非零的机会让步，但如果他们停止推广他们的应用，这个机会就会降至零。

唯一的获胜之举就是不玩。

children.author: dcminter
children.textRawHtml: Ah yes, I shall use that other auction site. Which was it again?
children.textZhHtml: 啊，是的，我将使用其他拍卖网站。又是哪一个？

children.author: inigyou
children.textRawHtml: Make your own. You could even scrape auctions from eBay. You might think it's impossible but every other country seems to have a homegrown one, and not many people habitually go to eBay.
children.textZhHtml: 自己制作。您甚至可以从 eBay 上抓取拍卖。你可能会认为这是不可能的，但其他国家似乎都有自己的本土国家，而且习惯上 eBay 的人并不多。

children.author: account42
children.textRawHtml: You can't scrape network effects. People don't want to buy something, they want to buy a specific thing and that is only available if there are enough users on the site for one of them to have your specific niche item. And no, not all countries have an equivalent with a user-base that even comes close to eBay.
children.textZhHtml: 您无法抓取网络效应。人们不想买东西，他们想买一件特定的东西，只有当网站上有足够的用户让其中一个人拥有你的特定利基商品时，这才可用。不，并非所有国家/地区都拥有与 eBay 相当的用户群。

children.author: port11
children.textRawHtml: Many per-country ‘competitors’ are actually owned by eBay.
children.textZhHtml: 许多国家/地区的“竞争对手”实际上归 eBay 所有。

children.author: dcminter
children.textRawHtml:
Such as Tradera in Sweden where I live (they don't try to make me install the app on Tradera at least).

If I'm buying random funkis furniture or computer bits and bobs I can probably use Tradera, and if I want fancy furniture or jewlery or something then there are coalitions of auction houses like Auctionet out there - but as soon as something gets even mildly obscure then there's nothing that has the reach and coverage of eBay.

Starting a new online auction site sounds like a terrific way to throw money away.
children.textZhHtml:
比如我居住的瑞典的 Tradera（他们至少不会试图让我在 Tradera 上安装该应用程序）。

如果我购买随机的 funkis 家具或电脑配件，我可能可以使用 Tradera，如果我想要精美的家具或珠宝或其他东西，那么那里有像 Auctionet 这样的拍卖行联盟 - 但一旦某些东西变得稍微模糊，那么就没有什么可以覆盖范围和覆盖范围eBay 的。

创建一个新的在线拍卖网站听起来是一个很棒的花钱方式。

children.author: port11
children.textRawHtml: It’s a two-sided marketplace, it’d take heaps of cash to crack.
children.textZhHtml: 这是一个双向市场，需要大量现金才能破解。

children.author: yunnpp
children.textRawHtml: These little easter eggs are why I read the comment section down to the Nth level of nesting.
children.textZhHtml: 这些小复活节彩蛋就是我阅读评论部分直至第 N 层嵌套的原因。

children.author: mey
children.textRawHtml: I have Firefox setup to not launch apps on android with permission.  I don't have Instagram/Facebook/etc installed.  Attempting to view a Instagram link on mobile is the most hostile thing in existence.  You essentially can't, but it so aggressively routes you to the website based Google play store it's horrifying.
children.textZhHtml: 我将 Firefox 设置为不在获得许可的情况下在 Android 上启动应用程序。  我没有安装 Instagram/Facebook/等。  尝试在移动设备上查看 Instagram 链接是最有敌意的事情。  你基本上不能，但它如此积极地将你引导到基于网站的 Google Play 商店，这太可怕了。

children.author: FridgeSeal
children.textRawHtml:
Whichever devs implemented the Instagram behaviour ought to have their computer taken off them.

100% the worst experience. “Oh you don’t have the app? No big deal, let’s (maybe) play the video anyway but remove the audio, obscure half the screen, and make any interaction redirect and then bounce to the App Store. Why won’t you download our app already????”
children.textZhHtml:
无论哪个开发者实施了 Instagram 行为，都应该把他们的电脑从他们身上拿下来。

100% 是最糟糕的体验。 “哦，你没有这个应用程序？没什么大不了的，我们（也许）还是播放视频吧，但删除音频，遮挡一半屏幕，进行任何交互重定向，然后弹到 App Store。你为什么不下载我们的应用程序？？？”

children.author: Sanzig
children.textRawHtml: They have to be pushy, it's how they install spyware which use tracking methods that would be a CFAA violation and prison time for anyone else: https://localmess.github.io/
children.textZhHtml: 他们必须咄咄逼人，这就是他们安装使用跟踪方法的间谍软件的方式，这将违反 CFAA 并对其他人造成监禁：https://localmess.github.io/

children.author: sfn42
children.textRawHtml: I don't use IG but my girl does and she likes to show me things. She does use the app and it drives me absolutely nuts how she tries to show me a video or image and I can't actually see/read the main point of it because there's a million gizmos (buttons etc) in the way that seem like they can't be hidden. Like actually 30% of the video is obscured by this pointless crap.
children.textZhHtml: 我不使用 IG，但我的女儿使用，而且她喜欢向我展示一些东西。她确实使用了这个应用程序，这让我非常抓狂，她试图向我展示视频或图像，但我实际上无法看到/阅读它的要点，因为有一百万个小玩意（按钮等），看起来似乎无法隐藏。事实上，视频的 30% 都被这种毫无意义的废话遮蔽了。

children.author: alex1138
children.textRawHtml: I've been told Zuckerberg - as opposed to murdering competition in the crib, despite him being ON RECORD IN EMAILS as saying 'they can hurt us' - bought a company that was barely anything. It "had 12 employees" or whatever. How they've "grown it" or whatever. Not what I see. I see it as competition killing. People really liked IG... in 2012. Now it's a poster child (or is that Whatsapp?) for antitrust
children.textZhHtml: 有人告诉我，扎克伯格买了一家几乎什么都不是的公司，而不是扼杀婴儿床中的竞争，尽管他在电子邮件中记录道“他们会伤害我们”。它“有 12 名员工”之类的。他们如何“种植它”或其他什么。不是我所看到的。我认为这是竞争的终结。 2012 年人们真的很喜欢 IG。现在它是反垄断的典型代表（或者是 Whatsapp？）
